dn1:0.1: suttantapiṭake dīghanikāyo sīlakkhandhavaggo namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammā sambuddhassa
dn1:1.1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā antarā ca rājagahaṃ antarā ca nālandaṃ addhānamaggapaṭipanno hoti mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi.
dn1:1.1.3: suppiyo’pi kho paribbājako antarā ca rājagahaṃ antarā ca nālandaṃ addhānamaggapaṭipanno hoti saddhiṃ antevāsinā brahmadattena māṇavena.
dn1:1.1.4: tatra sudaṃ suppiyo paribbājako anekapariyāyena buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, saṅghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
dn1:1.1.5: suppiyassa pana paribbājakassa antevāsī brahmadatto māṇavo anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
dn1:1.1.6: itiha te ubho ācariyantevāsī aññamaññassa ujuvipaccanīkavādā bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubaddhā honti bhikkhusaṅghaṃ ca.
dn1:1.2.1: atha kho bhagavā ambalaṭṭhikāyaṃ rājāgārake ekarattivāsaṃ upagaṃchi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
dn1:1.2.2: suppiyo’pi kho paribbājako ambalaṭṭhikāyaṃ rājāgārake ekarattivāsaṃ upagaṃchi saddhiṃ antevāsinā brahmadattena māṇavena.
dn1:1.2.3: tatra’pi sudaṃ suppiyo paribbājako anekapariyāyena buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, saṅghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
dn1:1.2.4: suppiyassa pana paribbājakassa antevāsī brahmadatto māṇavo buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
dn1:1.2.5: itiha te ubho ācariyantevāsī aññamaññassa ujuvipaccanīkavādā viharanti.
dn1:1.3.1: atha kho sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhitānaṃ maṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayaṃ saṅkhiyādhammo udapādi:
dn1:1.3.2: “acchariyaṃ āvuso, abbhutaṃ āvuso, yāvañcidaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sattānaṃ nānādhimuttikatā suppaṭividitā.
dn1:1.3.3: ayaṃ hi suppiyo paribbājako anekapariyāyena buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, saṅghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
dn1:1.3.4: suppiyassa pana paribbājakassa antevāsī brahmadatto māṇavo anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
dn1:1.3.5: itiha’me ubho ācariyantevāsī aññamaññassa ujuvipaccanīkavādā bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubaddhā honti bhikkhusaṅghaṃ cā”ti.
dn1:1.4.1: atha kho bhagavā tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ imaṃ saṅkhiyādhammaṃ viditvā yena maṇḍalamāḷo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. nisajja kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:
dn1:1.4.2: “kāya nu’ ttha bhikkhave etarahi kathāya sannisinnā sannipatitā? kā ca pana vo antarākathā vippakatā?”ti.
dn1:1.4.3: evaṃ vutte te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn1:1.4.4: “idha bhante amhākaṃ rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhitānaṃ maṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayaṃ saṅkhiyādhammo udapādi
dn1:1.4.5: “acchariyaṃ āvuso, abbhutaṃ āvuso, yāvañcidaṃ tena bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sattānaṃ nānādhimuttikatā suppaṭividitā.
dn1:1.4.6: ayaṃ hi suppiyo paribbājako anekapariyāyena buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, saṅghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
dn1:1.4.7: suppiyassa pana paribbājakassa antevāsī brahmadatto māṇavo anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
dn1:1.4.8: itiha’me ubho ācariyantevāsī aññamaññassa ujuvipaccanīkavādā bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubaddhā honti bhikkhusaṅghañcā’ti.
dn1:1.4.9: ayaṃ kho no bhante antarākathā vippakatā. atha bhagavā anuppatto”ti.
dn1:1.5.1: “mamaṃ vā bhikkhave, pare avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, dhammassa vā avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, saṅghassa vā avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, tatra tumhehi na āghāto na appaccayo na cetaso anabhiraddhi karaṇīyā.
dn1:1.5.2: mamaṃ vā bhikkhave, pare avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, dhammassa vā avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, saṅghassa vā avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, tatra ce tumhe assatha kupitā vā anattamanā vā, tumhaṃ yevassa tena antarāyo.
dn1:1.5.3: mamaṃ vā bhikkhave, pare avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, dhammassa vā avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, saṅghassa vā avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, tatra tumhe assatha kupitā vā anattamanā vā, api nu paresaṃ subhāsitaṃ dubbhāsitaṃ tumhe ājāneyyāthā?”ti.
dn1:1.6.1: “mamaṃ vā bhikkhave, pare avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, dhammassa vā avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, saṅghassa vā avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, tatra tumhehi abhūtaṃ abhūtato nibbeṭhetabbaṃ:
dn1:1.6.2: ‘iti’petaṃ abhūtaṃ. iti’petaṃ atacchaṃ. natthi cetaṃ amhesu. na ca panetaṃ amhesu saṃvijjatī’ti.
dn1:1.6.3: “mamaṃ vā bhikkhave, pare vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, dhammassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, saṅghassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, tatra tumhehi na ānando na somanassaṃ na cetaso ubbilāvitattaṃ karaṇīyaṃ.
dn1:1.6.4: mamaṃ vā bhikkhave, pare vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, dhammassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, saṅghassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, tatra ce tumhe assatha ānandino sumanā ubbilāvino, tumhaṃ yevassa tena antarāyo.
dn1:1.6.5: mamaṃ vā bhikkhave, pare vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, dhammassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, saṅghassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, tatra tumhehi bhūtaṃ bhūtato paṭijānitabbaṃ:
dn1:1.6.6: “iti’petaṃ bhūtaṃ, iti’petaṃ tacchaṃ. atthi cetaṃ amhesu. saṃvijjati ca panetaṃ amhesū’ti.”
dn1:1.7.1: “appamattakaṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave, oramattakaṃ sīlamattakaṃ, yena puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.
dn1:1.7.2: katamañca taṃ bhikkhave, appamattakaṃ oramattakaṃ sīlamattakaṃ, yena puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya?
dn1:1.8.1: “pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharatī”ti.
dn1:1.8.2: iti vā hi bhikkhave, puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.
dn1:1.8.3: “adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī athenena sucibhūtena attanā viharatī”ti.
dn1:1.8.4: iti vā hi bhikkhave, puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.
dn1:1.8.5: “abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī samaṇo gotamo ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā”ti.
dn1:1.8.6: iti vā hi bhikkhave, puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.
dn1:1.9.1: “musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassā”ti.
dn1:1.9.2: iti vā hi bhikkhave, puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.
dn1:1.9.3: “pisuṇaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo. ito sutvā na amutra akkhātā imesambhedāya. amutra vā sutvā na imesaṃ akkhātā amūsambhedāya. iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā, saṃhitānaṃ vā anuppadātā. samaggārāmo samaggarato samagganandī samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā”ti.
dn1:1.9.4: iti vā hi bhikkhave, puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.
dn1:1.9.5: “pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo. yā sā vācā neḷā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā, tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā”ti.
dn1:1.9.6: iti vā hi bhikkhave, puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.
dn1:1.9.7: “samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo, kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī, nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitanti”
dn1:1.9.8: iti vā hi bhikkhave, puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.
dn1:1.10.3: ekabhattiko samaṇo gotamo rattūparato virato vikālabhojanā.
dn1:1.10.21: iti vā hi bhikkhave, puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.

dn1:1.11.2: seyyathidaṃ: mūlabījaṃ khandhabījaṃ phalubījaṃ aggabījaṃ bījabījameva pañcamaṃ.

dn1:1.11.4: iti vā hi bhikkhave, puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.

dn1:1.12.2: seyyathidaṃ: annasannidhiṃ pānasannidhiṃ vatthasannidhiṃ yānasannidhiṃ sayanasannidhiṃ gandhasannidhiṃ āmisasannidhiṃ.

dn1:1.16.4: iti vā hi bhikkhave, puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.

dn1:1.17.4: iti vā hi bhikkhave, puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.
dn1:1.18.1: “yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ viggāhikakathaṃ anuyuttā viharanti.
dn1:1.18.2: seyyathidaṃ: na tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāsi. ahaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāmi. kiṃ tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānissasi? micchāpaṭipanno tvamasi, ahamasmi sammā paṭipanno. sahitaṃ me, asahitaṃ te. pure vacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca. pacchā vacanīyaṃ pure avaca. āciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattaṃ. āropito te vādo niggahito tvamasi. cara vādappamokkhāya. nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī’ti.
dn1:1.18.3: iti vā iti evarūpāya viggāhikakathāya paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo”ti.
dn1:1.18.4: iti vā hi bhikkhave, puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.

dn1:1.20.2: iti evarūpā kuhanalapanā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo”ti.

dn1:1.21.2: seyyathidaṃ: aṅgaṃ nimittaṃ uppātaṃ supinaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ mūsikacchinnaṃ aggihomaṃ dabbihomaṃ thusahomaṃ kaṇahomaṃ taṇḍulahomaṃ sappihomaṃ telahomaṃ mukhahomaṃ lohitahomaṃ aṅgavijjā vatthuvijjā khattavijjā sivavijjā bhūtavijjā bhūrivijjā ahivijjā visavijjā vicchikavijjā mūsikavijjā sakuṇavijjā vāyasavijjā pakkajjhānaṃ saraparittāṇaṃ migapakkhaṃ.
dn1:1.21.3: iti vā iti evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo”ti.

dn1:1.23.2: seyyathidaṃ: ‘raññaṃ niyyānaṃ bhavissati. raññaṃ aniyyānaṃ bhavissati. abbhantarānaṃ raññaṃ upayānaṃ bhavissati. bāhirānaṃ raññaṃ apayānaṃ bhavissati. bāhirānaṃ raññaṃ upayānaṃ bhavissati. abbhantarānaṃ raññaṃ apayānaṃ bhavissati. abbhantarānaṃ raññaṃ jayo bhavissati. bāhirānaṃ raññaṃ parājayo bhavissati. bāhirānaṃ raññaṃ jayo bhavissati. abbhantarānaṃ raññaṃ parājayo bhavissati’. iti imassa jayo bhavissati. imassa parājayo bhavissati.

dn1:1.27.3: iti vā iti evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo’ti.”
dn1:1.27.4: iti vā hi bhikkhave, puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.

dn1:1.28.1: atthi bhikkhave, aññeva dhammā gambhīrā duddasā duranubodhā santā paṇītā atakkāvacarā nipuṇā paṇḍitavedanīyā, ye tathāgato sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti, yehi tathāgatassa yathābhuccaṃ vaṇṇaṃ sammā vadamānā vadeyyuṃ.
dn1:1.28.2: katame ca te bhikkhave, dhammā gambhīrā duddasā duranubodhā santā paṇītā atakkāvacarā nipuṇā paṇḍitavedanīyā ye tathāgato sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti, yehi tathāgatassa yathābhuccaṃ vaṇṇaṃ sammā vadamānā vadeyyuṃ?
dn1:1.29.1: santi bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā pubbantakappikā pubbantānudiṭṭhino pubbantaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhivuttipadāni abhivadanti aṭṭhādasahi vatthūhi.
dn1:1.29.2: te ca bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā kimāgamma kimārabbha pubbantakappikā pubbantānudiṭṭhino pubbantaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhivuttipadāni abhivadanti aṭṭhārasahi vatthūhi?
dn1:1.30.1: santi bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sassatavādā sassataṃ attānañca lokañca paññāpenti catūhi vatthūhi.
dn1:1.30.2: te ca bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā kimāgamma kimārabbha sassatavādā sassataṃ attānañca lokañca paññāpenti catūhi vatthūhi?
dn1:1.31.1: idha bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappamanvāya padhānamanvāya anuyogamanvāya appamādamanvāya sammāmanasikāramanvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati yathāsamāhite citte anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
dn1:1.31.2: seyyathidaṃ: “ekampi jātiṃ dve’pi jātiyo tisso’pi jātiyo catasso’pi jātiyo pañca’pi jātiyo dasa’pi jātiyo vīsatimpi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattārīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi anekāni’pi jātisatāni anekāni’pi jātisahassāni anekāni’pi jātisatasahassāni amutrāsiṃ evannāmo evaṅgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto amutra upapādiṃ tatrāpāsiṃ evannāmo evaṅgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto idhūpapanno’ti.” iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
dn1:1.31.4: ‘sassato attā ca loko ca vañjho kūṭaṭṭho esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhito.
dn1:1.31.5: te ca sattā sandhāvanti saṃsaranti cavanti upapajjanti, atthitveva sassatisamaṃ.
dn1:1.31.7: ahaṃ hi ātappamanvāya anuyogamanvāya appamādamanvāya sammāmanasikāramanvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusāmi yathāsamāhite citte anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi.
dn1:1.31.8: seyyathidaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dve’pi jātiyo …pe… anekāni’pi jātisatasahassāni ‘amutrāsiṃ evannāmo evaṃgotto …pe… idhūpapanno’ti. iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi.
dn1:1.31.10: yathā sassato attā ca loko ca vañjho kūṭaṭṭho esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhito.
dn1:1.31.11: teva sattā sandhāvanti saṃsaranti cavanti upapajjanti atthitveva sassatisama”nti.
dn1:1.31.12: idaṃ bhikkhave, paṭhamaṃ ṭhānaṃ yaṃ āgamma yaṃ ārabbha eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sassatavādā sassataṃ attānañca lokañca paññāpenti.
dn1:1.32.1: dutiye ca bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā kimāgamma kimārabbha sassatavādā sassataṃ attānañca lokañca paññāpenti?
dn1:1.32.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappamanvāya padhānamanvāya anuyogamanvāya appamādamanvāya sammāmanasikāramanvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati yathā samāhite citte anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati –
dn1:1.32.3: seyyathidaṃ: ekampi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭaṃ dve’pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭāni tīṇi’pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭāni cattāri’pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭāni pañca’pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭāni dasa’pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭāni ‘amutrāsiṃ evannāmo evaṅgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto amutra upapādiṃ. tatrāpāsiṃ evannāmo evaṅgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto idhūpapanno’ti.” iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.

dn1:1.32.6: te ca sattā sandhāvanti saṃsaranti cavanti upapajjanti, atthitveva sassatisamaṃ.
dn1:1.32.8: ahaṃ hi ātappamanvāya …pe… tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusāmi yathā samāhite citte anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi –
dn1:1.32.9: seyyathidaṃ: ekampi …pe… dasa’pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭāni ‘amutrāsiṃ evannāmo …pe… idhūpapanno’ti. iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ aneka vihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi.
dn1:1.32.11: yathā sassato attā ca loko ca vañjho kūṭaṭṭho esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhito. teva sattā sandhāvanti saṃsaranti cavanti upapajjanti. atthitveva sassatisamaṃ’ti.”
dn1:1.32.12: idaṃ bhikkhave, dutiyaṃ ṭhānaṃ yaṃ āgamma yaṃ ārabbha eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sassatavādā sassataṃ attānañca lokañca paññāpenti.
dn1:1.33.1: tatiye ca bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā kimāgamma kimārabbha sassatavādā sassataṃ attānañca lokañca paññāpenti?

dn1:1.33.3: seyyathidaṃ: dasa’pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭāni vīsatimpi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭāni tiṃsampi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭāni cattārīsampi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭāni. “amutrāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto amutra upapādiṃ. tatrāpāsiṃ evannāmo evaṅgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto so tato cuto idhūpapanno’ti.” iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.

dn1:1.33.8: ahaṃ hi ātappamanvāya …pe… tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusāmi. yathāsamāhite citte anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi –
dn1:1.33.9: seyyathidaṃ: dasa’pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭāni …pe… cattārīsampi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭāni ‘amutrāsiṃ evannāmo …pe… idhūpapanno’ti. iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi.

dn1:1.34.1: catutthe ca bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā kimāgamma kimārabbha sassatavādā sassataṃ attānañca lokañca paññapenti?
dn1:1.34.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā takkī hoti vīmaṃsī. so takkapariyāhataṃ vīmaṃsānucaritaṃ sayampaṭibhānaṃ evamāha:
dn1:1.34.3: ‘sassato attā ca loko ca vañjho kūṭaṭṭho esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhito.
dn1:1.34.4: teva sattā sandhāvanti saṃsaranti cavanti upapajjanti atthitveva sassatisamanti.
dn1:1.34.5: idaṃ bhikkhave, catutthaṃ ṭhānaṃ yaṃ āgamma yaṃ ārabbha eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sassatavādā sassataṃ attānañca lokañca paññāpenti.
dn1:1.35.1: imehi kho te bhikkhave, samaṇabrāhmaṇā sassatavādā sassataṃ attānañca lokañca paññāpenti catūhi vatthūhi.
dn1:1.35.2: ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā sassatavādā sassataṃ attānañca lokañca paññāpenti, sabbe te imeheva catūhi vatthūhi etesaṃ vā aññatarena natthi ito bahiddhā.
dn1:1.36.2: ‘ime kho diṭṭhiṭṭhānā evaṃgahitā evaṃparāmaṭṭhā evaṃgatikā bhavissanti evaṃabhisamparāyā’ti.
dn1:1.36.3: tañca tathāgato pajānāti tato ca uttaritaraṃ pajānāti. taṃ ca pajānanaṃ na parāmasati. aparāmasato cassa paccattaññeva nibbuti viditā.
dn1:1.36.4: vedanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimutto bhikkhave tathāgato.
dn1:1.37.1: ime kho te bhikkhave, dhammā gambhīrā duddasā duranubodhā santā paṇītā atakkāvacarā nipuṇā paṇḍita vedanīyā ye tathāgato sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti, yehi tathāgatassa yathābhuccaṃ vaṇṇaṃ sammā vadamānā vadeyyuṃ.

dn1:2.2.1: hoti kho so bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena ayaṃ loko saṃvaṭṭati.
dn1:2.2.2: saṃvaṭṭamāne loke yebhuyyena sattā ābhassarasaṃvattanikā honti.
dn1:2.2.3: te tattha honti manomayā pītibhakkhā sayampabhā antalikkhacarā subhaṭṭhāyino ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti.
dn1:2.3.1: hoti kho so bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena ayaṃ loko vivaṭṭati.
dn1:2.3.3: athaññataro satto āyukkhayā vā puññakkhayā vā ābhassarakāyā cavitvā suññaṃ brahmavimānaṃ upapajjati.
dn1:2.3.4: so tattha hoti manomayo pītibhakkho sayampabho antalikkhacaro subhaṭṭhāyī ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ tiṭṭhati.
dn1:2.4.1: tassa tattha ekakassa dīgharattaṃ nibbusitattā anabhirati paritassanā uppajjati:
dn1:2.4.3: atha aññatare’pi sattā āyukkhayā vā puññakkhayā vā ābhassarakāyā cavitvā brahmavimānaṃ upapajjanti tassa sattassa sahavyataṃ.
dn1:2.4.4: te’pi tattha honti manomayā pītibhakkhā sayampabhā antalikkhacarā subhaṭṭhāyino ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti.
dn1:2.5.1: tatra bhikkhave, yo so satto paṭhamaṃ upapanno tassa evaṃ hoti:
dn1:2.5.2: ‘ahamasmi brahmā mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sajitā vasī pitā bhūtabhavyānaṃ.
dn1:2.5.6: aho vata aññe’pi sattā itthattaṃ āgaccheyyunti.
dn1:2.5.7: iti mamañca manopaṇidhi. ime ca sattā itthattaṃ āgatā’ti.

dn1:3.21.5: kāmā hi bho aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā tesaṃ vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā.

dn1:3.72.2: ye hi keci bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā pubbantakappikā vā aparantakappikā vā pubbantāparantakappikā vā pubbantāparantānudiṭṭhino pubbantāparantaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhivuttipadāni abhivadanti, sabbe te imeheva dvāsaṭṭhiyā vatthūhi antojālīkatā ettha sitā’va ummujjamānā ummujjanti, [nimujjamānā nimujjanti.] ettha pariyāpannā antojālīkatā’va ummujjamānā ummujjanti, [nimujjamānā nimujjanti.]
dn1:3.72.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, dakkho kevaṭṭo vā kevaṭṭantevāsī vā sukhumacchikena jālena parittaṃ udakadahaṃ otthareyya, tassa evamassa: “ye kho keci imasmiṃ udakadahe oḷārikā pāṇā, sabbe te antojālīkatā ettha sitā’va ummujjamānā ummujjanti, [nimujjamānā nimujjanti]. ettha pariyāpannā antojālīkatā’va ummujjamānā ummujjanti, [nimujjamānā nimujjantī”ti.]
dn1:3.72.4: evameva kho bhikkhave ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā pubbantakappikā vā aparantakappikā vā pubbantāparantakappikā vā pubbantāparantānudiṭṭhino pubbantāparantaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhivuttipadāni abhivadanti, sabbe te imeheva dvāsaṭṭhiyā vatthūhi antojālīkatā ettha sitā’va ummujjamānā ummujjanti, [nimujjamānā nimujjanti.] ettha pariyāpannā antojālīkatā’va ummujjamānā ummujjanti, [nimujjamānā nimujjanti.]
dn1:3.73.2: yāvassa kāyo ṭhassati, tāva naṃ dakkhinti devamanussā.
dn1:3.73.3: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā na naṃ dakkhinti devamanussā.
dn1:3.73.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ambapiṇḍiyā vaṇṭacchinnāya yāni kānici ambāni vaṇṭapaṭibaddhāni, sabbāni tāni tadanvayāni bhavanti,
dn1:3.73.5: evameva kho bhikkhave ucchinnabhavanettiko tathāgatassa kāyo tiṭṭhati.
dn1:3.73.6: yāvassa kāyo ṭhassati, tāva naṃ dakkhinti devamanussā.

dn1:3.74.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn1:3.74.2: ‘acchariyaṃ bhante, abbhutaṃ bhante, ko nāmāyaṃ bhante dhammapariyāyo?’ti
dn1:3.74.3: “tasmātiha tvaṃ ānanda, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ atthajālanti’pi naṃ dhārehi. dhammajālanti’pi naṃ dhārehi. brahmajālanti’pi naṃ dhārehi. diṭṭhijālanti’pi naṃ dhārehi. anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo’ti’pi naṃ dhārehī”ti.
dn1:3.74.5: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
dn1:3.74.6: imasmiṃ ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne dasasahassī lokadhātu akampitthāti.
